title: T1 ideation: three verified corrections for UMD CI repair design
body: While producing T1 Proposed Approaches for ADVERSARIAL-universal-media-decomposer-ci-repair.md, direct file reads at 2026-08-28 (HEAD a6b1a62) verified: (1) the three test_live_hatchet_* shape tests in tests/test_hatchet_live.py are ALREADY repaired in the committed tree — they use a real SDK client + real DurableStageExecutor + _poll_until, contradicting handoff §6 (which describes the older executor=None/_RecordingClient state); what remains unproven is live execution itself, not test structure. (2) CapabilityReporter (src/umd/jobs/capability.py) has NO connectivity probe — returns configured-but-unavailable whenever env is set, so _require_production_path in test_api_boundary_e2e.py would skip even against a live stack; a real connectivity probe is a mandatory repair for the public-boundary E2E gate to ever pass. (3) The debugger report artifacts/designs/process/universal-media-decomposer-ci-repair-debugger.md is MISSING from disk — noted in the DD; failure analysis relies on support-researcher report + first-hand reads. Approach A (Commit-and-Wire + capability probe) ranked top; C's pre-flight docker manifest inspect recommended to fold in.

title: GHCR v0.105.2 tag verified on all sub-path repos; top-level 403 confirmed
body: T3 (CI-repair adversarial): direct manifest HEAD checks against GHCR (2026-08-28) close T2's open pagination gap. HTTP 200 for v0.105.2 manifest on all four sub-path repos: ghcr.io/hatchet-dev/hatchet/{hatchet-engine,hatchet-lite,hatchet-admin,hatchet-migrate}. Top-level ghcr.io/hatchet-dev/hatchet/manifests/v0.105.2 returns 403 (exact class of the CI daemon error). Tag-list pagination alone cannot reach v0.10x quickly (alphabetical, 800+ tags, many arch/date variants); the manifest HEAD check is the same operation Docker performs and is the authoritative existence proof. Repair target confirmed: compose.yaml:104 + src/umd/jobs/hatchet.py:56 must switch from top-level path to split sub-paths.

title: SDK v1 surface mismatches confirmed against official Hatchet docs
body: T3 validation (2026-08-28): (a) task handler signature — official V1 migration guide (docs.hatchet.run/v1/migrating/migration-guide-python) states tasks take TWO positional args (input, ctx), input is a Pydantic model defaulting to EmptyModel; tree _make_handler(payload) is one-arg and indexes payload["input"]["manifest"] → live-run blocker. (b) submission surface — "SDK Improvements in V1" (docs.hatchet.run/v1/migrating/v1-sdk-improvements): "The AdminClient has been removed... use hatchet.runs.create... replaces the old hatchet.admin.run_workflow"; all client fns are verbs (runs.list/create); Workflow.run/Standalone.run preferred; tree runs.admin_client().run_workflow(name, json.dumps(input)) targets the removed surface (PR #1413 "don't export admin client anymore"). Both recorded in ADVERSARIAL log Refined Approaches §5; first-live-run cycle is arbiter.

title: T3 refinement complete: A refined + C folded, B post-green, D rejected
body: T3 refinement of T1 approaches against T2 critique (appended to artifacts/designs/process/ADVERSARIAL-universal-media-decomposer-ci-repair.md, line 447+, append-only). A (Commit-and-Wire) REFINED as primary: gate polarity flipped in the SAME commit as uncommitted fixes, UMD_VALIDATE_LIVE_WORKER removed as user-settable; backend default = ProductionDAGRunner (fail-closed, capabilities active only when wired + cached probe passes); live shape tests run inside a container on the compose network (A-3, in-network pattern, gramps-mcp precedent); CapabilityReporter probe = cached background probe with failureThreshold/successThreshold ≥ 2 on engine gRPC 7070. C FOLDED into A (manifest-inspect tripwire only, no allow-failure, pip-index probe dropped). B REFINED as post-green complement (no trigger-level path filter on live job for main; always-running gate job with always() that fails if live job skipped/succeeded-missing — GitHub docs + Latchkey + LinkedIn Venice). D REJECTED documented (lite = dev-only per official docs, gRPC 7077 vs hardcoded 7070, no split auth vars, current compose matches neither topology). Debugger integration: single-image pip install .[worker] packaging decision (SDK needed by worker role AND in-API capability probe), JobService async status reconciliation (queued→RUNNING, COMPLETE only from worker-callback stage_run rows), image-path repair target. Everything else PROVISIONAL pending first-live-run (SDK pair C4, handler/submission alignment, split-topology env var names, probe timing).
